ValidationRule.description: GST Number's first two digits (GST state code) must belong to the Lead's State (short code or State GST Code record name). Mapping mirrors State_GST_Code__mdt; keep both in sync.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(IsVRBypassed__c), NOT($Permission.Lead_VR_Bypass), NOT(ISBLANK(GST_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(State)), REGEX(GST_Number__c, "[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]"), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(GST_Number__c), ISCHANGED(State)), NOT(CONTAINS( CASE(LEFT(GST_Number__c, 2), "01", "|JK|JAMMU AND KASHMIR|JAMMU & KASHMIR|", "02", "|HP|HIMACHAL PRADESH|", "03", "|PB|PUNJAB|", "04", "|CH|CHANDIGARH|", "05", "|UK|UTTARAKHAND|", "06", "|HR|HARYANA|", "07", "|DL|DELHI|", "08", "|RJ|RAJASTHAN|", "09", "|UP|UTTAR PRADESH|", "10", "|BR|BIHAR|", "11", "|SK|SIKKIM|", "12", "|AR|ARUNACHAL PRADESH|", "13", "|NL|NAGALAND|", "14", "|MN|MANIPUR|", "15", "|MZ|MIZORAM|", "16", "|TR|TRIPURA|", "17", "|ML|MEGHALAYA|", "18", "|AS|ASSAM|", "19", "|WB|WEST BENGAL|", "20", "|JH|JHARKHAND|", "21", "|OD|ORISSA|", "22", "|CG|CHHATTISGARH|", "23", "|MP|MADHYA PRADESH|", "24", "|GJ|GUJARAT|", "26", "|DH|DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI|DAMAN|DAMAN AND DIU|DAMAN & DIU|", "27", "|MH|MAHARASHTRA|MUMBAI|", "29", "|KA|KARNATAKA|", "30", "|GA|GOA|", "31", "|LD|LAKSHADWEEP|", "32", "|KL|KERALA|", "33", "|TN|TAMILNADU|TAMIL NADU|", "34", "|PY|PONDICHERY|PUDUCHERRY|", "35", "|AN|ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR|ANDAMAN & NICOBAR|", "36", "|TS|TELANGANA|", "37", "|AP|ANDHRA PRADESH|", "38", "|LA|LADAKH|", "|NONE|"), "|" & UPPER(TRIM(State)) & "|" )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The GST Number does not belong to the State on this Lead. The first two digits of the GST Number must match the Lead's State.
